# Nova API — /api/version

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/version`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## GET /api/version

Operation id `nova_version`: in Python `client.call("nova_version", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api nova_version`.

The version and commit of the running Nova process: `version` is `NOVA_VERSION` when the deployment sets it and the crate version otherwise, `commit` is `NOVA_COMMIT` or `unknown`. Nothing is fetched and nothing leaves the instance.

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | The running version |
| `401` | No token to sign in with |
